# Phase 1 independent change verification

Verdict: PASS after correcting a material proof fixture identity defect. Native verify-change mode, implementation mutation sensitivity plus a separate evidence/closure audit. Baseline is published `c79bdb516f4a4fe343bb97c1c97b39f0d796c450` on `design-base`, including preserved uncommitted and untracked work. The canonical technical record is `evidence.md`, *Independent Phase 1 verification and exact JSON correction (2026-10-07)*.

No ticket became DONE during verification. DSR-1.6 remains DONE at 5/5, DSR-1.7 at 6/6 approved bounded dispositions, and DSR-1.9 at 7/7 after the operator's continue decision. No acceptance box was reopened. DSR-0.6's deployment volume, visibility/preservation semantics, effect isolation and responsible Security owner decision still blocks DSR-2.1 and DSR-4.1. The single next action is preparing that decision.

## Scope and corrections

Prior implementation compared with the published baseline includes SDK `_runner.py`, `_defer_hook.py`, `_skill_package.py`, package exports, the existing `write_recovery.py` and `host_session_offline.py` fixtures, package/admission tests and canonical specification/plan/evidence/work-items/budget disposition. Untracked package implementation and tests were included, rather than omitted from the diff.

Verification changed exactly these external repository files, relative to `python/claude_agent_sdk/`:

- `docs/skill-recovery/experiments/write_recovery.py`: compare original pending/outcome/receipt and approved inputs as JSON, preserving Boolean/integer/float distinctions and refusing nonfinite/unserializable values; retain object key equivalence and array order.
- `tests/session_control/test_experiment_admission.py`: direct omitted-status, parser, host lane and exact identity boundary controls.
- `tests/session_control/test_skill_package.py`: direct package metadata/invocation/snapshot controls, both read decision routes, source options, native shell settings and both child identity fields.
- `tests/test_tool_policy.py`: reject changed already answered pending identity.
- `docs/skill-recovery/evidence.md`: authoritative verification result and limits.
- `docs/skill-recovery/work-items.md`: verification pointer and current approved exit routing, preserving earlier historical paragraphs.

Private canonical pointer, ticket README/status map and Phase 1 checkpoint were synchronized. This report records the audit. SDK source, exports, host supervisor, specification, plan, dependency files and all other pre-existing source/document bytes remained unchanged by verification. Original raw archives, publication manifests, historical failures and consumed reservations were preserved.

Initial coverage weaknesses were material to verification completion and were corrected with direct tests. Intermediate test fixture errors were corrected and their failed captures preserved. An unmutated real SDK reconstruction probe separately proved the fixture accepted `0` in place of `false` in question input, pending identity, ownership and `is_error`. The original implementation mutation report therefore remains FAIL. A fresh verifier pair inspected and tested the narrowing correction; retained question records already use the correct Boolean values. No runtime report was relabeled or model experiment repeated.

Initial mutation matrix had 34 kills, seven survivors and three inconclusive rows. Test strengthening produced direct kills for every initial unresolved case. Across those matrices, 84 distinct guards have direct kills in 95 executions; the separate unmutated JSON identity defect superseded that first implementation verdict. The correction's fresh matrix has 11 kills, zero survivors, zero inconclusive and zero blocked, each pytest FAIL in the predeclared intended test. Failures caused by exposed unsafe fallthrough exceptions are attributed to those tests; collection/instrumentation failures are preserved and not counted as kills.

Correction baseline, unrelated documentation control and final refresh each pass 509 controls, two skips and 13 deselections. Valid question/package outputs agree byte for byte, SHA-256 `0a91693c539d3a22fb6eef83c4ae93e29a990941936cc2bab6c6da1d908ca183`; changing a package body changes its emitted fingerprint. The lead inspected every follow-up capture and intended attribution, exact valid bytes and cleanup receipts. SDK/host public production source is unchanged. ## Independent roles and source classification

Distinct fresh contexts: implementation_contract, implementation_mutations, evidence_contract, evidence_adversarial, then identity_contract and identity_mutations after the fixture behavior correction. Contract/evidence roles read the real tree without writes; mutation roles use separate temporary copies and the existing supervisor/image. Reports are `/tmp/DSR-verify-change-20261007-implementation-contract.md`, `-mutations.md`, `-evidence-contract.md`, `-evidence-adversarial.md`, `-identity-contract.md`, `-identity-mutations.md`. The original mutation report remains FAIL; both fresh correction roles report PASS with no unresolved material finding. The lead read all full reports and reran applicable checks.

Installed `temporal-workflow-design-critic` actually ran against the bounded original composition. It found no material domain issue. Classification is partial precedent: ordinary Activities, retry and idempotency guidance support primitives; exact pending transcript and host fencing composition remains bounded project proof. Sources include https://docs.temporal.io/activity-definition#idempotency and Atlas pointed `features/features/activity/retry_on_error/feature.py` / `canary-go/retry.go`. This correction adds JSON comparisons, not a new Temporal mechanism. Simplicity classification is idiomatic explicit parameters and immutable snapshots, with no new global side channel; primary explicitness guidance is https://peps.python.org/pep-0020/.

## Limits and next action

Qualified inputs come from JSON-loaded SDK transcripts, Temporal payloads and ownership receipts. The helper compares JSON representations; arbitrary Python tuple/list or non-string dictionary key type identity is outside that contract. Supplemental fabricated Python-object probes remain preserved and do not supply a reachable qualified bypass. Some malformed ownership records abort with KeyError, AttributeError or JSONDecodeError rather than a unified AdmissionRefused taxonomy; no continuation occurs.

This is complete offline Linux/Python 3.13 default suite evidence, not every skipped/native/platform test or a new model recovery qualification. Retained complete successful question Workflow/history remains unavailable; original parser/coordinator failures, stop-condition violation, null consumed accounting and unverified actual charges/headroom remain accepted limits. General host loss, volume/claims, signed decisions and release promotion remain later gates. The 1,101-export publication archive was not republished or wholly rehashed. The known legacy private checker findings remain unchanged, not a passing check.

No live model call, credential inspection, dependency installation, upgrade, image build/pull, external contact, commit or push occurred. No reservation was created or consumed. Next: prepare DSR-0.6's volume and effect isolation decision; implementation remains blocked on that operator/security choice.
